sn22.8:1.2: upādāparitassanañca vo bhikkhave, desissāmi. anupādā aparitassanañca.
sn22.8:1.5: idha bhikkhave, assutavā puthujjano rūpaṃ “etaṃ mama, eso’hamasmi eso me attā”ti samanupassati.
sn22.8:1.6: tassa taṃ rūpaṃ vipariṇamati, aññathā hoti.
sn22.8:1.11: viññāṇaṃ “etaṃ mama, eso’hamasmi, eso me attā”ti samanupassati.
sn22.8:1.12: tassa taṃ viññāṇaṃ vipariṇamati, aññathā hoti.
sn22.8:2.2: idha bhikkhave, sutavā ariyasāvako rūpaṃ “netaṃ mama, neso’hamasmi, na meso attā”ti samanupassati.
sn22.8:2.3: tassa taṃ rūpaṃ vipariṇamati, aññathā hoti.
sn22.8:2.8: viññāṇaṃ “netaṃ mama, neso’hamasmi, na meso attā”ti samanupassati.
